evergreen_age_ceiling.statement: The posting's age is below the point where an unfilled posting is more likely evergreen recruiting than a live vacancy.

no_hires_since_posting.statement: No hires have been observed into this function at this company since the posting date.

posting_still_listed.statement: The posting was still listed on the most recent source scrape.

vacancy_duration.description: A job posting whose signal strength climbs with age. Recency weighting is structurally blind to reversal here, so every falsifier below has to be re-asked on a schedule.
